# University of Minnesota Twin Cities

> The University of Minnesota Twin Cities is a top-10 public research institution offering comprehensive academic programs, health sciences education, and Big Ten athletics.

Twin Cities serves as the flagship campus of the University of Minnesota system, located in Minneapolis-St. Paul. The site provides information for prospective students, current students, researchers, and alumni across all major academic disciplines and campus services.

## Key Topics

- Admissions
- Undergraduate Programs
- Graduate Programs
- Research Opportunities
- Majors & Programs
- Tuition & Financial Aid
- Scholarships

- Land-Grant University

## Academics & Admissions

- [Academics and Admissions](https://twin-cities.umn.edu/academics-admissions): Academic programs, admissions information, tuition, financial aid, and scholarships overview.
- [All Program Search](https://twin-cities.umn.edu/academics-admissions/majors-programs): Searchable directory of all undergraduate and graduate degree programs.

## About the University

- [University of Minnesota Twin Cities](https://twin-cities.umn.edu): University of Minnesota Twin Cities homepage with overview of programs, research, and student life.
- [About Us](https://twin-cities.umn.edu/about-us): University mission, history, land-grant status, and institutional overview.
- [Alumni](https://twin-cities.umn.edu/alumni): Alumni community resources, networking, career services, and engagement opportunities.

## Research & Innovation

- [Research](https://twin-cities.umn.edu/research): Research overview highlighting top-10 public research university discovery and innovation.
- [Blood test may predict survival after 70](https://twin-cities.umn.edu/news-events/blood-test-may-predict-survival-after-70): Research on microRNA biomarkers for longevity prediction using AI technology.

## Student Experience

- [Student Life](https://twin-cities.umn.edu/student-life): Student housing, dining, organizations, health resources, and campus life at Twin Cities.
- [Health Sciences](https://twin-cities.umn.edu/health-sciences): Health sciences programs, nursing, public health education, patient care, and research.
- [Gopher Athletics](https://twin-cities.umn.edu/gopher-athletics): Gopher Athletics Big Ten sports programs and student-athlete information.

## News & Campus Stories

- [News & Events](https://twin-cities.umn.edu/news-events): University news, events, research highlights, and campus announcements.
- ['Everything you want is on the other side of fear'](https://twin-cities.umn.edu/news-events/everything-you-want-other-side-fear): Alumni profile: Hollywood director David Leitch on liberal arts education.
- [Gophers to host first two rounds of NCAA tournament](https://twin-cities.umn.edu/news-events/gophers-host-first-two-rounds-ncaa-tournament): Women's basketball NCAA tournament hosting announcement and first-round matchup.
- [Minnesota Carlson students create strategy to grow dental access](https://twin-cities.umn.edu/news-events/minnesota-carlson-students-create-strategy-grow-dental-access): MBA student consulting project expanding pediatric dental care access.
